description: This file defines the MySQLi class within the Opencart or system library, which manages database connection, query execution, escaping, and connection status for MySQL databases using mysqli extension. It encapsulates connection setup, including SSL configuration, and provides methods for executing queries and handling results.
external_files: mysqli.php (the PHP mysqli extension implicitly used)

classes.name: MySQLi
classes.description: A class that manages MySQL database interactions, including connection setup with SSL support, executing queries, escaping strings, and managing connection lifecycle.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the database connection based on provided options, including SSL setup if specified.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes a SQL query and returns a result object or boolean, wrapping mysqli result set if applicable.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe inclusion in SQL queries.

methods.name: countAffected
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last query.

methods.name: getLastId
methods.description: Retrieves the last inserted ID from an insert operation.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the database connection is active.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Closes the database connection and cleans up SSL temporary files upon object destruction.
